title: getagentseal/codeburn
claim: getagentseal/codeburn — Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 31 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini
why_good: Tracks AI-coding token spend across 31 agents locally — the cost side of the agent boom nobody instruments, and it's the number buyers actually watch.
value: Sell a team dashboard + budgets/alerts to eng leaders who must cap and attribute agent spend across seats.
risk: Each agent vendor can add native usage metering, and a free local tracker is easy to clone.
pick_reason: The tool addresses a specific need for cost management in AI development, allowing for a clear monetizable product.

zh.claim: getagentseal/codeburn —— 免费本地工具,跨 31 种工具/agent(Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini)追踪 AI 编码的 token 用量与花费。
zh.why_good: 在本地追踪 31 种 agent 的编码 token 花费——agent 热潮里没人做的成本侧,而这正是买家真正盯的数字。
zh.value: 给工程负责人卖团队看板 + 预算/告警:跨席位设上限、把花费归因。
zh.risk: 每个 agent 厂商都能加原生用量计量,免费本地追踪器也容易被抄。
